I have only a small piece of land, just 0.08 hectares for this sorghum plot. Chemical fertilizer is too costly and hard to find in the market, so I will use manure from my animals to make the soil strong. I will plant the sorghum seed I saved from last year's harvest because it is what I know and trust. My children and I can do all the work ourselves since the plot is small, and we depend on the rains because there is no water nearby for irrigation.
